verdict.rationale: BVNK documents programmatic crypto and fiat wallet creation via API, including wallets created on behalf of specific customers (bvnk-docs-4, bvnk-docs-25), with Hawk-signed API access (bvnk-docs-29). A probe also found an official agent-wallet-cli repository (bvnk-probe-2), but the pack shows nothing of what it does. Nothing shows agent-specific wallet issuance, keys scoped per agent, or policy and spending controls on what an agent can move. Missing for 10: agent-scoped or restricted API keys, policy controls (allowlists, approvals), documented per-agent transfer or spend limits, and details or hands-on corroboration of the agent-wallet-cli.
